column1: # Tamil (ta) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty          a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code (`tl!("…")`,
#                           a menu label, or a name the UI translates with `i18n::t`)
#   escapes  \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns;
#            translators may reorder them. A trailing "…" (dialog commands) is kept.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English text using ordinary
# Tamil video-editing vocabulary (தடம், துண்டு, வரிசைத் தொகுப்பு, காலவரிசை, குறிப்பான், முக்கியச்
# சட்டகம், வசனங்கள்…). No proprietary localisation resource, string table or product UI was
# consulted or copied, and no other FilmCraft catalog was translated from; add entries the same
# way. Product, technology and format names (FilmCraft, ArtCraft, ProRes, LUFS, H.264…) keep their
# spelling, as do key-cap names (Shift, Alt, Ctrl, Cmd, Opt, Esc).
# Labels are noun phrases; commands are imperatives (சேமி, நீக்கு, அகற்று); digits stay 0–9.
# Most entries come from the Tamil FilmCraft catalog in craft-i18n (locales/ta/filmcraft.tsv and
# common.tsv), reviewed for language and terminology by native speakers; the rest are AI-assisted
# translations, not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
